description: Phase 8 Adaptive Branching truthset for query-complexity classification. Labels are route-oriented: CLASS_A maps to direct flat vector lookup, CLASS_B maps to multi-hop graph traversal, and CLASS_C maps to global or hierarchical retrieval. Queries are seeded from the Phase 7 SIGINT PDF passages and GDPR benchmark anchors.

CLASS_A.name: Simple
CLASS_A.description: Direct lookup, factoid, acronym, section, or single-policy retrieval.

CLASS_B.name: Multi-hop
CLASS_B.description: Relationship, conflict, overlap, lineage, or cross-document linkage retrieval.

CLASS_C.name: Global
CLASS_C.description: Corpus-level synthesis, thematic summarization, comparison, or policy posture retrieval.
